_comment: Optional per-repo overrides for the README's Featured projects section. Any public repo pushed in the last year appears automatically; entries here only improve its title, blurb, stack line, live demo URL ('homepage'), 'palette' ([badge primary, badge secondary, card surface, card accent]: badges use the app's light-theme colors, the card shows its dark theme; surface defaults to secondary, accent to primary), or 'fonts' ({title, body, stack} as 'Google Font Family:weight'; stack defaults to body; unset = system font). Repos listed in 'hidden' never appear.

Worktrack.blurb: A job-search tracker with an application pipeline, analytics, and a CV builder that keeps every version. Row-level security scopes every table to the signed-in user, and a demo mode shows the real screens over sample data without an account. Continues a project started by [Ensues](https://github.com/Ensues).
Worktrack.stack: Next.js 15 · React 19 · Supabase Postgres · TanStack Query · Tiptap · Vitest

Smart-HRMS.title: Smart HRMS
Smart-HRMS.blurb: An HR platform with role-based access for employees, evaluators, HR, and PMT officers, backed by four Python modules: rule-based leave and IPCR routing, a linear-regression performance predictor, a real-time attendance analytics dashboard, and a training recommender. Ships as a desktop app through Electron.
Smart-HRMS.stack: Laravel 12 · React 19 · Inertia.js · MySQL · Python · Electron · Pest

baguio-city-3d.title: Baguio 3D
baguio-city-3d.blurb: An interactive 3D map and field guide to Baguio City: real-elevation terrain, six jeepney routes with a fare calculator, a four-era history timeline, and an eat-and-stay directory. Geospatial data lives in PostGIS and is served through Next.js route handlers with Redis caching, with no paid map keys.
baguio-city-3d.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · MapLibre GL · PostgreSQL / PostGIS · Prisma · Redis

4chan-redesign.title: Clover
4chan-redesign.blurb: A 4chan redesign that keeps the boards, anonymity, and bump-order threads, and rebuilds everything a reader touches: a real type scale, OKLCH color tokens, and 107 test-first components on Radix primitives. Board and thread data comes from 4chan's read-only JSON API.
4chan-redesign.stack: Laravel · Inertia.js · React · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · Pest

aero_weather.title: AeroWeather
aero_weather.blurb: A single-page weather dashboard with current conditions, air quality, and a two-week outlook for any city, plus saved places and an interactive map. No account and no backend: preferences stay on the device.
aero_weather.stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Leaflet · Vitest
